visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black crop top, a black and white plaid shirt worn loosely over her shoulders, and black baggy pants, stands in an indoor studio with purple neon lighting. She begins a dance routine, starting with a hand-stopping gesture toward the camera. (2) She moves into high-energy choreography, performing sharp arm movements, torso sways, and rhythmic footwork. Her facial expression shifts from focused to smiling. The background consists of industrial-style ceiling beams and a reflective glass partition reflecting neon lights. (3) The choreography becomes more dynamic with large hair flips and circular arm motions. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot. She executes several synchronized steps, her plaid shirt fluttering with her movements. (4) The routine transitions into a slower rhythmic swaying phase where she runs her hand through her hair and smiles. Finally, she poses by making finger-gun gestures toward the lens, maintaining a playful and confident expression until the video ends.
